title: [DK Nemhandel][Currency] Remove unsafe fixed response-size caps on scaling/customer-configured feeds
summary: Removed unsafe fixed byte-size caps on integration responses that scale with customer data, relying instead on platform limits and structural validation for the Nemhandel and currency exchange rate services.
key_points: Removed 64 KB cap on Nemhandel API that falsely rejected legitimate large companies with many registered receivers
Removed 10 MB cap on currency exchange rate downloads where legitimate responses grow annually and vary by provider format
Kept caps on genuinely bounded responses: VIES checkVat (64 KB) and MTD IP lookup (4 KB)
Relies on platform HttpClient 150 MiB absolute limit for memory/DoS protection and schema validation for integrity
Nemhandel responses measured from 0.5 KB (Mærsk) to 97 MB (Region Midtjylland); ECB full-history feed 7.8 MB and growing
